terminal-bg.usage: Body background, panel bodies, code blocks, inputs, and scroll tracks.

selection-surface.usage: Hover rows, panel headers, selected table background, and subtle grouping.

comment-muted.usage: Secondary text, inactive navigation, borders, baselines, timestamps, and disabled-adjacent metadata.

cyan-action.usage: Hover links, upload or in-progress status, file size data, metadata values, and secondary action hints.

green-ready.usage: Active navigation, successful state, downloaded state, and positive confirmation actions.

orange-working.usage: Warnings, dirty state, labels, reload markers, and operational attention.

pink-heading.usage: Section headers, table headers, logs/config headers, and high-level page titles.

purple-primary.usage: Primary buttons, focus borders, brand prompt accent, and selected control emphasis.

red-error.usage: Errors, destructive hover states, offline status, and failed cache or log states.

yellow-override.usage: Explicit override state and rare caution markers.

display.purpose: The buzz prompt and rare high-emphasis console labels.

title.purpose: Uppercase panel and table headers with one-pixel letter spacing.

body.purpose: Default UI copy, metadata, and control text.

data.purpose: Tables, logs, YAML blocks, and configuration bodies.

label.purpose: Chips, reload modes, timestamps, baselines, and compact metadata.

elevation.philosophy: Flat terminal panels with structural borders. Glow and shadow only indicate active or changed state.

motion.philosophy: Avoid decorative animation and layout movement. Motion is limited to state attention and overflowing text support.
motion.reducedMotion: Disable marquee-style overflow motion when prefers-reduced-motion is reduce.

navigation.character: Prompt-style top navigation with compact links, inline counts, route color states, and mobile icon-only collapse.

tables.character: Dense operational tables with sticky uppercase headers, compact row height, hover selection, and mobile column pruning.

forms.character: Raw configuration fields grouped by fieldset with visible defaults, reload mode, dirty state, and override state.

logs.character: Terminal pane with timestamp, source, level, message, and quiet copy controls.

dos: Keep the interface compact, dense, and self-guiding.
Use Dracula colors for state, syntax, categories, and affordances.
Keep panels flat, bordered, and stable during polling or refreshes.
Preserve raw configuration visibility and direct form controls.
donts: Do not make buzz look like flashy SaaS, a gamified media app, a mobile-first consumer product, or a cloud-account dashboard.
Do not hide raw configuration details behind opaque wizards.
Do not add heavy JavaScript requirements for basic navigation, configuration, or inspection.
Do not introduce repaint-heavy updates that shift the UI around while users read or interact.
